title: Expansion: which market do we enter next?
question: We have budget for one international launch next year. Which market should we enter?
context: Consumer fintech app with 2M users in India. Strong brand with students and young professionals; payments licence held only domestically.
constraints: Must not jeopardise the domestic payments licence

options.title: UAE remittance corridor
options.description: Target the Indian diaspora with remittances back home; partner bank available.

options.title: Indonesia and Vietnam wallet launch
options.description: Large unbanked youth market, but needs local e-money licences and new partners.

options.title: EU crypto trading feature
options.description: Ride the crypto trend in the EU through an unlicensed offshore entity.
